_comment: Engine -> pip packages map. Engines install ON DEMAND: when the user starts a model that needs one (strictly into the project environment). install_size_text is shown in the install dialog.

faster-whisper.title: faster-whisper (CTranslate2)
faster-whisper.note: Already part of the base installation.

whispercpp.title: whisper.cpp (pywhispercpp)
whispercpp.note: Installed automatically when you start a GGML model (whisper.cpp).

vosk.title: Vosk (Kaldi)
vosk.note: Installed automatically when you start a Vosk model.

qwen-asr.title: Qwen3-ASR (transformers + PyTorch)
qwen-asr.note: Installed automatically on the first run of a Qwen3-ASR model (once; later runs download nothing). Requires transformers 5.13+ — earlier versions do not support Qwen3-ASR.
qwen-asr.install_size_text: ~0.2–1 GB (most of it is PyTorch; depends on the system)

gigaam.title: GigaAM (Sber, transformers + PyTorch)
gigaam.note: Needed for the Russian GigaAM (Sber) models and the multilingual line. Installed ON DEMAND, ONCE: the heaviest part is PyTorch (~120–200 MB for the CPU build or a CUDA build with an NVIDIA GPU), the rest is small. soundfile is required: the model code itself (modeling_gigaam.py) imports it. Later runs download nothing.
gigaam.install_size_text: ~0.2–1 GB (most of it is PyTorch; depends on the system)

hf-transformers.title: Transformers (любая ASR-модель Hugging Face)
hf-transformers.note: Installed automatically on the first run of an HF model (once).
hf-transformers.install_size_text: ~0.2–1 GB (most of it is PyTorch; depends on the system)

cuda.title: NVIDIA CUDA 12 (cuBLAS + cuDNN 9)
cuda.note: Offered automatically when you pick a GPU device. On Windows the system cuDNN9/cuBLAS DLLs are additionally required (see requirements/gpu.txt).
cuda.install_size_text: ~1 GB (cuBLAS + cuDNN for an NVIDIA GPU)
